Via Sport JBM Football Club
Backed by club sponsor Hale Outdoor. Kitted out by Puma. Boxer is our grocery partner.

A place of healing

Via Sport exists to give young players from South African townships a platform to step up to professional football.

The partners give back to the communities of Alexandra, Katlehong, Thokoza, Vosloorus, Soweto and Thembisa, and want the club to be a place of healing for them.

Mpho Makola

HEAD COACH

Former Orlando Pirates and Bafana Bafana midfielder. Won his first trophy as a coach in 2024/25.

The climb

  1. 2024/25: Regional champions

    Via Sport won the SAFA Johannesburg Hollywoodbets Regional League, Makola's first trophy as a coach. The national playoffs for promotion to the ABC Motsepe League came up short.

  2. The JBM move

    To speed things up, the club bought the status of JBM FC, already in the Gauteng ABC Motsepe League, with five matches left in the 2024/25 season.

  3. Third tier, first season: 11th

    Via Sport now plays in the Gauteng ABC Motsepe League, South Africa's third tier, and fields a team in the SAB League, the fourth tier. Finishing 11th in that first season was a historic result for the club.

  4. Now

    A new season begins with one stated goal.

    Promotion or nothing.

Kathorus Hyper Academy

Developing young talent. Defying expectations.

A youth development academy in Vosloorus, Gauteng, and a partner of Via Sport.

Since 2015 the academy has developed young players and competed in the Gauteng Development League. It has earned a reputation as a giant slayer for its results against larger academies such as Mamelodi Sundowns and Kaizer Chiefs.

From age 12, players can see the whole route: age groups run from Under-13 to Under-19, with structure, coaching and exposure, and the dream of playing for the first team.

U13U15U17U19First team

The academy has been backed since 2024 by Mitak, an engineering firm, which helps keep a strong development environment running for its players.
